query:
select distinct execution_process_id as "process_id!",
  execution_process_start_time_ticks as "start_time_ticks?"
from auto_step_run
where run_id = ? and execution_process_id is not null
union
select distinct execution_process_id as "process_id!",
  execution_process_start_time_ticks as "start_time_ticks?"
from plan_step_run
where run_id in (
  select plan_run_id from auto_step_run where run_id = ? and plan_run_id is not null
) and execution_process_id is not null
